summary: Iter 113 duty-context surface verified on Pietro's client dashboard (mobile viewport 390x844). All 7 visible dates render exactly as expected: 07-28 shows Run Easy + 'LAYOVER · NBO · BLUE' info block; 07-29 shows REST FROM TRAINING + info block with layover city + flight leg 'EK770 NBO → AUH 07:05-13:15  32A'; 07-30 shows REST FROM TRAINING + TURNAROUND header + two flight legs (332 and 333, aircraft 320); 07-31 / 08-01 / 08-02 (home_day) render workout with NO duty info block (clean look); 08-03 (STANDBY, rest) shows REST FROM TRAINING + STANDBY header with no flights and AMBER load pill. V2 rationale + IMPORTANT/KEY priority pill from iter112 continues to render on Run Easy, Strength Full Body, Run Long. No lint errors, no console errors introduced by this change (only pre-existing warnings: shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents deprecations, expo-notifications). 08-04 was NOT observed because the pre-existing NEXT 7 pager button does not advance the range on web (see minor issue below), but the same STANDBY roster context is proven by 08-03 which renders correctly.

issues: The duty header row uses flexWrap: 'wrap' and the load pill has marginLeft:'auto'. When layover_city is present without flights, the layover city and the load pill wrap onto their own lines producing a slightly loose 3-line stack (LAYOVER / · NBO / BLUE). Not a bug — content is fully readable — but a compact single-line render (or hiding the load pill when city is shown) would look tighter.

react_native_issues.issue: day_type='layover_departure' is not in the dutyChip label map, so it falls back to auto-Title-Case ('Layover Departure') and the info block header reads 'LAYOVER DEPARTURE' instead of the reviewer-expected 'LAYOVER · NBO'. Functionally correct and clearly readable, but the main-agent-specified label is not exact. Consider mapping layover_departure -> {label:'Layover', icon:'bed', tone:'amber'} (same as layover_full) for consistency. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ClientCalendarPanel.tsx:144-170

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add 'layover_departure' (and likely 'layover_arrival') entries to the buildDutyChip map in ClientCalendarPanel.tsx so the info block header renders as 'LAYOVER' (matching the review spec) instead of the auto-Title-Cased fallback 'LAYOVER DEPARTURE'.

Blocked verification of 2026-08-04 STANDBY+Run Easy card via UI, though the same STANDBY block was proven on 2026-08-03. Worth a separate iter to debug Pressable click handling for these pager buttons on web (they use disabled + testID cal-prev-7 / cal-next-7).
